Description: Established in 2016 as a tribute to the 36 artists who lost their lives in the Ghost Ship fire, Vital Arts was born to honor the memory of those who sought a safe haven for their art and lives, with a mission to transform the conditions in the Bay Area so that artists can not only survive but thrive in their communities. We advocate for all artists who are historically left out of conversations concerning housing, particularly Queer and Trans, BIPOC, and disabled artists. Through coalition building, exhibitions, performances, workshops, and other events, we actively engage with the local community, promoting dialogue and generative cultural exchange to best provide resources for those facing housing and space insecurity. Our primary mission is to establish and uphold affordable, secure spaces tailored for artists to live, work, and perform.
